text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One Friday, while she was hard at work
training for the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
That concludes today's menu, then.
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Well then, could we talk a bit after this
about our voluntary training starting tomorrow... for the weekend?
choice_data_list: Huh, you're doing voluntary training this weekend?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...? That's what I intend to do, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing her look of bewilderment, I couldn't help but ask another question.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Ligne Droite", commonly known as Droit, is a dance party held in spring. Dressed in gorgeous outfits, all the Umamusume enjoy dancing the night away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As an event celebrating both the end of the year and the coming of the new semester,
it is apparently quite lively despite being optional, but...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
............Ah, well.
Now that you mention it, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Her long pause before nodding
spoke volumes.
Knowing Believe's personality..."
choice_data_list: (True, it does seem like an event she wouldn't be interested in……)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although, there are some who choose to focus purely
on independent training. If they truly do not
wish to participate, then—
W-W-W-Waiiiit a secondーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Dantsu-san?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um...
I-I'm so sorry for cutting in!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
But I overheard your conversation, and before I knew it,
or rather, how should I put it...
I mean, um, that is...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
—Believe-chan!!
Would you... dance with me!?

text_block_list.name: Droite Executive Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
—Costume rental reception will begin shortly~!
Please wait just a little longer—!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ah... Dants-san, sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Believe-chan! No, it's okay. Looks like the committee members are still preparing anyway."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, thank you for coming today.
I didn't have the courage for the longest time, so I ended up inviting you at the very last second..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So we didn't even have matching brooches as proof of our pair, and we only had time to get rented outfits...
Ugh, everything was so poorly organized...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm not really particular about that sort of thing...
and there was no real reason to refuse, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Honestly though, it's strange.
Dantsu-san—"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Why did you invite me?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Umm... Part of it is that you helped me out so, so much during the Classic year, but—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Above all else... well, that's—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Because I started feeling all frustrated and restless, that's why!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Uneasy?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Because! The other girls were saying it too, but—
even I was super surprised!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Believe-chan is... Well, because. I just totally knew you'd win a URA Award."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ah, about that...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Still not bothered by it, huh?
I figured that'd be the case with you, Believe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: —Still, I just felt so conflicted!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I hated the idea of that.
...Because deep down, I always want to be
in the center of the stage, bathed in applause."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Believe-chan. You know, I'm thinking of running in the Takarazuka Kinen this year. ...I want to enter, and I want to win!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Even now, I'm still trying my hardest
to become the leading star of this era."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "That's why. Even to you, who brought me out into the light—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I want them to be blessed and praised by everyone.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Because that's the way I want it to be!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
This time, with my own hands, I wanted you—
to stand right at the center of the dazzling spotlight!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no... now that I'm saying it out loud,
I'm being completely self-centered, aren't I...
S-Sorry about that, Believe-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No.
Dants-san just now was―

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I think they truly fit the role of the lead.

text_block_list.name: Droite Executive Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting! Costume rental registration is now open!
Anyone who's interested, please head right over here~!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Mm...!
Alright, let's meet up in the hall once we've changed!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "...Wait!! H-Huhhh~~~!?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry. I was fully expecting Dantsu-san to wear a dress...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I-I'm the one who thought you should wear a dress, since today is Believe-chan's time to shine...!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, ahaha. But isn't that fine?
There are plenty of girls dancing suit-with-suit
or dress-with-dress anyway.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Besides—!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If it's rental costumes, there are tons of outfits to change into!
So let's just have fun with it!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Believe-chan!
Both look great on you. You look so lovely!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —Dantsu-san too.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: H A L T !

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Belieeeeeeeeve!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: !? Whoa...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Enough about the past! Looking back?
That's far too late, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"We'll just run faster, just surge forward!!
Now—"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Dance with me next!
I challenge you at the Sprinters Stakes, Believe!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait... L-Light O-chan!
Believe-chan is my partner, you know~?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Or rather... why are you in your racing silk
for drawee duty in the first place!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There was a line forming at the costume rental counter.
That was why.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
By the way, earlier, I was much faster taking Believe's hand
than you were at stopping me.
Which means you've suffered a crushing defeat, Dantsu.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that what happens...!?
I wonder if it really turns out like that~...!?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me, Dantsu-san.
I'm going to talk with Light O-san for a moment."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I see. Alright, let's dance, Believe!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, I won't be dancing.
My date tonight is with Dantsu-san, you see.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It's just... earlier,
you were talking about the Sprinters Stakes, right?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
So you're running this year too, then.
You as well, Right O-san.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right.
In other words, it's a showdown, Believe.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I am fast.
—I have grown faster.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, you will not achieve consecutive victories.
Because I will claim that crown first.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...That's a bit surprising.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Knowing you, I expected you'd say
something like, "Let's settle this in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen right after!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I considered that too.
Or rather, I wanted to do that. But I decided against it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Because right now, if I try to run seriously,
my legs hurt so much my face scrunches up like a pickled plum.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, leg trouble?
...Is she going to be okay?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I was told I'd get better with a little rest.
So I'll rest a bit.
I want to run right away, but I'll rest."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Endure it, just a little.
—After enduring and persevering through it all,
you finally became the sprint queen last year."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"To be completely honest, it's frustrating as hell.
Even so—I can just barely hold out and wait."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "Because in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, there isn't a single Umamusume who could keep up with your speed."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way.
Believe, there is only one who runs ahead of you."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —Because I am the fastest.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, when it comes to the Takamatsunomiya Kinen,
I have no intention of yielding the title of the fastest.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: And at the Sprinters Stakes too.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The one out front. The fastest one.
Which one that is—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Let's decide it in autumn.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The Takamatsunomiya Kinen draws near.
Yet that stage is—likely just the prelude.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘Simply to be fast, the fastest of all.’
The battle between those who purely seek that goal is—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: From here on, the pillars of fire will rise higher and higher, burning fiercely.
